name: utils
title: Spark UI utilities
description: Shared helpers: class names, defaults and slots, tones, portal theming.

files.content:
/** Join class names, skipping falsy values. */
export const cx = (...parts: Array<string | false | null | undefined>) => parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ');

/** The four tones every coloured component accepts. Styled via `[data-tone]` in base.css. */
export type Tone = 'brand' | 'error' | 'success' | 'warning';
